Title: Lord Ashton v Guide and Mentor

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
From a discussion on the discord rules channel, I stumbled across

www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/10134-guide-and-mentor-questions?start=0#26687

which calls out a difference between the rulings on Lord Ashton's action and Guide and Mentor's action, which, as far as I know, as never been formally addressed.

While very minor, it would be nice if we can get some official clarification / unification of the rulings.

--
National Coordinator
South Africa

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: The Lord Ashton ruling is incorrect. No one pressed LSJ on it, but it's clearly in conflict with his later rulings.

REVERSAL of groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/Y0NrK_JeEGA/m/FzWk5RD2bSwJ: Lord Ashton allows another Gangrel (even with all Disciplines at superior) to search the library for a Discipline card, and fail to find it if it cannot be played.

Name: Lord Ashton
[Anarchs:PG]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Gangrel
Group: 3
Capacity: 5
Discipline: for pro ANI
Independent: Any other Gangrel can search his or her controller's library for an Animalism, Fortitude or Protean Master: Discipline card and move it to himself or herself as a +1 stealth action.
